title: Run gateway
description: Per-run tokens and the loopback model proxy (F3 item T; body B1 api; design section 2, DC-04). bin/run_token.py mints a token for every run and stores only its sha256 (index key run_tokens); bin/model_proxy.py swaps a token of an api link for the real key (bin/credentials.py) and forwards to the connection's catalog host only. bin/capabilities_mcp.py serves the capability tools to a run over loopback HTTP (section mcp; item M). Owner-only: only the owner path writes it.

prefix.description: The fixed start of every token, so a leak scanner can find one in a log or a file.

random_bytes.description: Random bytes after the prefix (urlsafe base64).

ttl_s.description: A token's life when mint names no --ttl; it must exceed the longest run (a token that expires mid-run stops the run's model calls).

bind.description: The address the proxy listens on: loopback only (model_proxy.py refuses any other, STL-MDL-799).

port.description: The port when serve names no --port; 0 = ephemeral (the bound port goes to the index key model_proxy_state).

max_body_bytes.description: The largest request body forwarded (STL-MDL-795 above it).

forward_headers.description: Client headers passed upstream (lower case). Every other client header is dropped, and an auth header of any protocol never passes, whatever this list says.

forward_query.description: Query parameters passed upstream; every other one is dropped (a query could carry a key).

mcp.description: The capability MCP server (F3 item M; body B4, B6): MCP over streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0 POSTs on one path, the run token as the only credential; role, card and run come from the token record.

bind.description: The listen address: loopback only (capabilities_mcp.py refuses any other, STL-GRD-680).

port.description: The port when serve names no --port; 0 = ephemeral (the bound port goes to the index key capabilities_mcp_state).

path.description: The one path that takes JSON-RPC POSTs; GET on it is 405 (no event stream), any other path 404.

hosts.description: Host header (and Origin) names accepted, without port or brackets: loopback names only, so a rebound DNS name is refused (STL-GRD-676).

auth_header.description: The header (lower case) that carries the run token.

auth_scheme.description: The scheme word before the token in that header (case-insensitive).

max_body_bytes.description: The largest request body read (413, STL-GRD-677 above it).

timeout_s.description: Socket timeout of one connection and of the thin client's call.

protocol_versions.description: MCP protocol versions served, newest first: initialize answers the client's when listed, else the first.
